scope: Independent model-assisted bounded review and scratch probes of the additive draft natal codec. No human review, industry protocol adoption, account/storage migration, network calls, publication, or deployment implied.
findings: No remaining concrete blocking finding in this bounded review. Earlier accepted exact known-time pole geometry and duplicate JSON requiredFeatures/schema counterexamples were fixed by the codec owner and new preflight helper, then rerun.
limitations: Finite synthetic corpus, not exhaustive proof or ephemeris accuracy certification.
Temporal controls use the observed Node 22 ICU/tzdb; they are not independent evidence of universal historical timezone truth.
Local-resolution metadata and provenance remain supplied claims checked for arithmetic/shape consistency, not authenticated facts.
Proxy traps may execute when JavaScript object descriptors/prototypes are inspected; these probes check fixed error sanitization, not sandboxing of arbitrary same-realm JavaScript.
The helper only preflights JSON structure: semantic values such as nonfinite native numeric conversion are rejected by the outer codec.
